ironore:
Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite sheet for Relight's approved painted top-down mining nodes. Square canvas, EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows of equal-sized cells. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no background colour, no checkerboard baked in. Genuine transparent alpha background including between fragments. Each sprite entirely within its cell with at least 12% transparent margin on all four sides, centered at the same pivot. No fragments crossing cell boundaries. Camera is almost vertical overhead (85 degrees above ground), flat shallow walkable mineral beds, broad top faces, narrow thickness, consistent soft upper-left lighting and tight subtle contact shadows. Crisp detailed hand-painted 2D industrial game illustration, muted believable colours, readable at small scale, not tiny pixel art, not photorealistic and not a 3D isometric object. No tile-shaped bases, no plants, no ground rectangles, no UI borders.
Columns: three different deterministic natural cluster silhouettes A, B, C.
Rows: top FULL richness (about 7–10 shallow fragments), middle PARTLY MINED (about 4–5 of the same fragments removed from each corresponding top cluster, leave natural gaps, don't scale the whole cluster smaller), bottom NEARLY EXHAUSTED (only 1–2 small pieces and a few chips, same tile pivot). All rows are the same physical cell size; density decreases downwards. Approximately matched fragment positions in each column across the stages. Resource: IRON ORE. Shallow angular slate blue-grey fractured rock plates with muted rusty red mineral fissures and a few pale cool metallic exposed facets. Predominantly slate grey, restrained red-brown streaks. No tall upright boulders, mountain peak, ingots or finished metal.
